title: Use libx264 for H264 CPU fallback
summary: Route H.264/NVENC CPU fallback through the libx264 descriptor and surface selected fallback encoder evidence.
reason: H.264/NVENC primary flags were descriptor-owned, but CPU fallback still used the old libx265 branch and hard-coded libx265 evidence.
behavior_before: H.264/NVENC CPU fallback used the generic CPU/libx265 branch, and fallback events/logs reported libx265 even when the requested video codec was H.264/NVENC.
behavior_after: H.264/NVENC CPU fallback plans use descriptor-owned libx264 flags, while Dynamic HDR/HEVC fallback remains libx265; fallback events/logs report the selected CPU encoder.
